verdict_rationale: A critical security invariant (authentication lockout) is violated on a reachable, session-less recovery command (P5-ADV-001). The candidate also fails the existing required verify:replication governance gate (P5-ADV-002) and does not enforce financial-integrity verification at the production restore boundary (P5-ADV-003), with four reproduced detector false negatives. Business-data ownership fencing, crash consistency, and fail-closed startup reconciliation were independently verified and are sound; they are not the basis for NO-GO. No finding was downgraded to reach this verdict.

findings.title: Owner-resolution command has no brute-force lockout and grants an unlocked Owner session
findings.code_path: Tauri resolve_interrupted_recovery -> with_recovery_review_workspace -> verify_scope_readonly (no session) -> Workspace::resolve_interrupted_recovery -> recovery::resolve_interrupted. Reads owner retry_after and workspace_access.retry_after and honors an existing lockout, but on wrong password returns InvalidPassword without incrementing failed_attempts or setting retry_after (global or principal), and writes no session.unlocked audit. On success sets store.1 = Some(session) (unlocked Owner).
findings.attack_scenario: While the workspace is fenced (interrupted recovery after a crash), an attacker with local access to the registered, session-less Tauri command makes unlimited Owner-password guesses. The persistent 5-attempt/60s lockout that protects normal login is never engaged through this path; a correct guess yields a fully unlocked Owner session controlling all financial data.
findings.expected_invariant: Owner authentication must enforce the persistent brute-force lockout (failed_attempts increment, retry_after at threshold) on every authentication path, including recovery resolution; existing authentication safeguards must not be weakened.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: 25 consecutive wrong passwords all return InvalidPassword; local_principals and workspace_access failed_attempts/retry_after remain (0,0,0,0); the correct password then unlocks an Owner session and releases the fence.
findings.impact: Security: removal of the authentication rate-limit safeguard for the root Owner credential in the recovery scenario; unlimited online guessing (Argon2-bounded per attempt) plus full Owner session grant on success.
findings.recommended_remediation: Mirror login_at: increment global and principal failed_attempts, set retry_after at the threshold, audit failed resolution attempts, and add a regression test asserting lockout engages through the resolution path.

findings.title: Existing verify:replication governance gate fails on the candidate
findings.code_path: node scripts/verify-replication.mjs compiles replication-cloud + mobile-contracts (succeeds), then asserts /const SCHEMA_VERSION: i64 = 12;/ against lib.rs (candidate is 13) -> AssertionError 'financial schema remains 12'. A later assertion requires desktopMain.includes('reset_sidecar_file'), which the candidate removed.
findings.attack_scenario: Not an attack; a regression. The candidate changed schema version and sidecar behavior but did not update the harness, so the project's required verification gate (npm run verify:replication, part of npm run verify) exits non-zero.
findings.expected_invariant: The candidate must pass the project's existing required governance/verification gates.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: REPLICATION_EXIT=1; AssertionError 'financial schema remains 12'. git diff baseline..candidate -- scripts/verify-replication.mjs is empty (harness unchanged). reset_sidecar_file occurrences in desktop main = 0.
findings.impact: Release-blocking governance regression; the candidate's verification suite fails. The audit did not weaken assertions.
findings.recommended_remediation: Update the harness to v13 invariants (schema 13; sidecar reset removed) without weakening assertions, and make verify:replication pass.

findings.title: Financial-integrity verification is test-only and not enforced at the production restore boundary
findings.code_path: restore_owned T3 calls integrity() (PRAGMA cipher_integrity_check / integrity_check / foreign_key_check) only. financial_violations is referenced nowhere outside tests (repository-wide search). Comment: 'Deep financial-invariant verification is test-only by design.'
findings.attack_scenario: A backup whose financial data is logically invalid but structurally intact (e.g., logical on-disk corruption) passes validate() + integrity() and is imported and marked completed without financial verification.
findings.expected_invariant: Recovery must verify financial invariants at the restore boundary so it cannot silently commit invalid financial state.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: Production restore performs structural verification only; the deep financial verifier is test-only. End-to-end silent corruption was NOT demonstrated (schema validation requires the full trigger set; write-time triggers constrain normal data).
findings.reproduction_evidence: Source inspection (restore_owned T3; financial_violations cfg(test)); detector false negatives P5-ADV-004..007 reproduced in docs/reviews/phase5-adversarial-evidence/adversarial-all-12.txt
findings.impact: Financial-integrity guarantee is not enforced at the production boundary; the test oracle that underpins the claim is incomplete.
findings.recommended_remediation: Promote a hardened financial verifier out of #[cfg(test)] and run it inside the restore transaction before completion; reject backups that violate financial invariants.

findings.title: Verifier misses a deleted credit-sale entry (customer outstanding understated)
findings.code_path: Check 5: SELECT c.invoice_id FROM local_credit_entries c JOIN local_billing_ledger l ON l.invoice_id=c.invoice_id AND l.account='receivables' WHERE c.kind='sale' AND l.amount_paise<>c.amount_paise. INNER JOIN yields no row when the credit entry is deleted; billing ledger stays balanced.
findings.attack_scenario: On-disk corruption or tampering deletes a credit sale's local_credit_entries row; customer outstanding balance is understated and the verifier reports clean.
findings.expected_invariant: Every credit sale must have a matching credit entry; outstanding balance must reconcile.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: After DELETE of the kind='sale' entry, SUM(amount_paise) for the customer changes but financial_violations returns empty.
findings.impact: Financial: understated receivables/outstanding undetected by the integrity oracle.
findings.recommended_remediation: Add a check that every credit invoice has a corresponding credit entry (LEFT JOIN / NOT EXISTS), independent of ledger balance.

findings.title: Verifier misses tampered repayment/opening_due credit entries
findings.code_path: Check 5 filters c.kind='sale' only; repayment/opening_due/write_off entries are not cross-checked against the customer journal.
findings.attack_scenario: Tampering a repayment credit entry amount changes customer outstanding balance; the customer journal is untouched and balanced, so the verifier reports clean.
findings.expected_invariant: All credit entry kinds must reconcile with the customer journal/outstanding balance.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: UPDATE local_credit_entries SET amount_paise=amount_paise+5000 WHERE operation_id='cash-collection' leaves financial_violations empty.
findings.impact: Financial: outstanding balance manipulation undetected for non-sale credit kinds.
findings.recommended_remediation: Cross-check every credit kind against the customer journal and recompute outstanding balances.

findings.title: Verifier misses a balanced billing-ledger tamper versus invoice total
findings.code_path: Check 1 groups local_billing_ledger by invoice_id HAVING SUM(amount_paise)<>0. Shifting amount between revenue and cash keeps SUM=0; no check reconciles ledger legs to the invoice total.
findings.attack_scenario: A balanced tamper (revenue -100, cash +100) keeps the ledger zero-sum but the revenue leg no longer matches the invoice; the verifier reports clean.
findings.expected_invariant: Ledger postings must reconcile to the invoice total, not merely sum to zero.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: After the balanced shift, financial_violations returns empty while the revenue leg drifts from its original value.
findings.impact: Financial: revenue/cash misstatement undetected when balance is preserved.
findings.recommended_remediation: Reconcile ledger legs to the stored invoice total/tax and tender breakdown.

findings.title: Verifier misses a duplicated balanced retail journal
findings.code_path: local_retail_journal has sequence PK but no UNIQUE(operation_id,account). The verifier checks retail journal SUM per operation and outbox duplicates, but has no duplicate-journal check. Duplicating a balanced posting set keeps SUM=0.
findings.attack_scenario: On-disk duplication of a retail operation's postings double-counts revenue/cash while remaining zero-sum; the verifier reports clean.
findings.expected_invariant: Journal postings must be unique per operation/account; duplication must be detected.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: After duplicating the balanced set, financial_violations returns empty although a GROUP BY operation_id,account HAVING COUNT(*)>1 query detects duplicates.
findings.recommended_remediation: Add a duplicate-journal detector and a UNIQUE(operation_id,account) guard for local_retail_journal.

findings.title: Unfenced metadata tables writable via raw SQL while fenced (bounded)
findings.code_path: The engine fence triggers cover only the 40 FENCED_TABLES. workspace_access (lockout counters) and local_recovery_identity (business_id, generation) have no fence trigger; local_recovery_identity has no immutability trigger.
findings.attack_scenario: A session-less raw-SQL writer resets workspace_access lockout counters or tampers local_recovery_identity.generation while a recovery fence is active.
findings.expected_invariant: No unfenced writes that affect security/recovery identity during a live fence; no business-identity substitution.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: audit_b1: UPDATE workspace_access and UPDATE local_recovery_identity SET generation succeed while fenced; a business write (local_products) is rejected. audit_b2: business_id substitution is caught fail-closed at startup (RecoveryCorrupt).
findings.impact: Defense-in-depth gap: lockout reset and generation tamper between transactions; bounded by fail-closed startup for business substitution and by the writer lock during restore. Not a business-data ownership breach.
findings.recommended_remediation: Extend fencing/immutability to local_recovery_identity and workspace_access, or document and bound the metadata trust model; cross-check generation consistency.

findings.title: Cloud in-memory dedup is cross-generation while durable Postgres dedup is per-generation
findings.code_path: ingest.ts dedups by `${businessId}|${operationId}` (cross-generation). postgres.ts dedups by (business_id, restore_generation, stream, operation_id) (SQL UNIQUE line 50). After a restore rotates the generation, Postgres would not dedup against the prior generation's events.
findings.attack_scenario: Post-restore re-publication of the same operationId under a new generation is deduped in-memory (duplicate=true) but could be re-projected by the Postgres path; journal/credit projection idempotency is not guaranteed by the per-generation key.
findings.expected_invariant: Consistent dedup semantics across reference and durable paths; no double-projection of financial events after restore.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: Probe: gen-2 redelivery of a gen-1 operation returns duplicate=true (in-memory). Postgres per-generation key confirmed by source/SQL; not executed (no Postgres instance).
findings.impact: Potential cloud-side double-projection of financial events after restore; requires production-path verification.
findings.recommended_remediation: Align dedup semantics and verify projection idempotency for journals/credits across in-memory and Postgres paths.

findings.title: owner_token and generation format are not validated
findings.code_path: owner_token/generation are produced by random_id() (hex) but neither admission nor reconciliation validates their format/length; pairing checks assume well-formed values.
findings.attack_scenario: A tampered-but-nonempty token/generation that still satisfies fence pairing is not rejected on format alone.
findings.expected_invariant: Recovery identity tokens/generations should be validated for expected format.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: No format validation observed in admit or reconcile_startup (source inspection).
findings.impact: Low; values are internal and pairing-checked.
findings.recommended_remediation: Validate token/generation format (length/charset) at admission and reconciliation.

findings.title: clippy -D warnings yields pre-existing style lints; plain gate passes
findings.code_path: cargo clippy --all-targets (plain) exits 0 with 17 lib warnings (19 in test cfg). Adding -D warnings promotes them to errors (exit 101): too_many_arguments, needless_borrow, type_complexity, redundant_pattern_matching, manual RangeInclusive contains.
findings.attack_scenario: Not a security defect; style lints, predominantly pre-existing baseline code.
findings.recommended_remediation: Optionally address style lints; not release-blocking.

independently_verified_invariants.invariant: Business-table fence blocks session-less raw SQL writes
